_comment: Project-scoped MCP servers for the Factoidal repo. Loaded by Claude Code at session start; requires one-time per-project user approval. Future contributors can pre-approve via `claude mcp` or by accepting the prompt on first session.

fstar._comment: F* IDE-protocol bridge from FStarLang/fstar-mcp. fstar-mcp is HTTP-only (Streamable HTTP transport) — it's started as a background daemon by tools/sandbox-bootstrap.sh on session start, and Claude Code connects over HTTP. The port (3700) is shared with tools/fstar-mcp-server.sh via FSTAR_MCP_PORT; change both if you need a different one.

lean-lsp._comment: Lean 4 LSP bridge (lean-lsp-mcp, PyPI) for the formal/lean4 L4Factoidal port: per-file diagnostics, goal states at a position, hover docs, and loogle/leansearch lemma search. Runs over stdio via uvx (installed by `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh`). Tools operate on absolute file paths under formal/lean4/; the server auto-detects the lake project root.
